trait RequiredMember[T] {
    required(x: T) -> T;
}

class MissingMember : RequiredMember[Int] {
}

class WrongMember : RequiredMember[Int] {
    required(x: String) -> String { x }
}

class GoodMember : RequiredMember[Int] {
    required(x: Int) -> Int { x }
}

class BaseMember {
    convert(x: Int) -> Object { x }
}

class BadOverride < BaseMember {
    convert(x: String) -> Int { 1 }
}
